name: YS LeadGen – Popup & Form Builder to Capture More Leads, Grow Subscribers & Boost Sales
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS LeadGen is a popup and form builder for WordPress. It helps you grow your email list, capture leads, and reduce WooCommerce cart abandonment.

Build exit intent popups, opt-in forms, coupon popups, spin-to-win wheels, and lead forms from your own WordPress dashboard, using a visual drag-and-drop editor — no separate app and no outside account required.

  • Design popups and forms in a visual, drag-and-drop editor.
  • Embed forms anywhere on your site with a shortcode or block — in your sidebar, footer, or inside a post.
  • Works with the page builder you already use — Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, or Bricks Builder.
  • Your lead data stays inside your own WordPress database. It only leaves if you turn on an integration yourself.

See a live demo | Browse popup templates | Read the documentation

Why YS LeadGen?

  • Free to start, no time limit. The free plan isn’t a trial — it stays free for as long as you use it.
  • No separate account required. Everything runs from your own WordPress dashboard.
  • Your data stays yours. Leads and reports live in your WordPress database, not a third-party dashboard.
  • Built for WooCommerce. Cart abandonment, checkout exit-intent, and coupon popups are purpose-built for store owners, not bolted on.
  • 17 popup and form types in one plugin, so most sites won’t need to combine multiple lead-gen plugins.

Popup Types You Can Build

  • Exit Intent Popups — shows a popup when a visitor’s mouse movement indicates they’re about to leave the page.
  • Lightbox Popups — a popup in the center of the screen, commonly used for email opt-ins, coupon codes, or WooCommerce offers.
  • Coupon Popups — displays a discount code at a set trigger point.
  • Floating Bars — a bar at the top or bottom of the page for shipping info, announcements, or countdowns, without covering page content.
  • Slide-In Popups — slides in from a corner of the screen.
  • Fullscreen Popups & Welcome Mats — takes over the full screen on page load or trigger.
  • Countdown Popups — displays a live timer, useful for time-limited offers or launches.
  • Spin-to-Win Popups — a gamified spin-the-wheel format for coupon distribution.
  • Multi-Step Popups — splits a longer form into smaller steps.
  • Yes/No Popups — asks a question first, then shows a follow-up offer based on the answer.
  • Inline Forms — a signup form placed inside blog post or page content.
  • Embedded Forms — a lead capture form placed anywhere via shortcode or block.
  • Survey & NPS Popups — collects visitor feedback or a rating.
  • Social Proof Popups — displays recent signups or sales.
  • Video Popups — shows a YouTube, Vimeo, or self-hosted video inside a popup.
  • Content Lockers — hides content until a visitor signs up or completes an action.
  • Age Gate & Cookie Consent Popups — verifies visitor age or collects cookie consent.

Free vs. Paid Plans

YS LeadGen is free to install and use. The table below shows what’s included in the free plugin compared with the entry-level paid plan (Starter), so you know what to expect before you build a campaign. Higher paid tiers exist with additional limits and features not covered here — see pricing for the full comparison.

Included in Free:

  • Up to 3 active popups, with a limited number of campaigns.
  • Core popup types: Entry, Lead, Bar, and Coupon popups.
  • Basic visitor triggers (e.g. time delay, page load) and basic targeting rules.
  • A limited selection of templates.
  • The full drag-and-drop builder.
  • Basic integrations and a limited number of webhooks.
  • Basic analytics with 7 days of history.
  • Community (forum-based) support.

Requires a paid plan (Starter and up):

  • Unlimited active popups and campaigns.
  • Cart abandonment popups and advanced coupons.
  • Advanced visitor triggers, including event-based and inactivity triggers.
  • Advanced targeting, including geo, device, and traffic-source targeting, plus scheduling.
  • Access to 100+ premium templates.
  • Advanced layouts and conditional blocks.
  • Advanced integrations and unlimited webhooks.
  • Advanced analytics with unlimited history.
  • Lead export and storage.
  • Branding removal.
  • Live chat and email support.

White Label mode and Team Collaboration, added in 2.1.8, are available on paid plans — they are not part of the free plugin.

An Easy Popup Builder With Ready-Made Templates

Search the template library by goal, industry, or popup type, then adjust colors, text, and layout in the visual editor. The free plan includes a limited set of templates; the full library (100+) is available on paid plans.

Exit Intent: Catch Visitors Before They Leave

Exit intent detects signals that a visitor is about to leave — such as moving the mouse toward the browser’s close button — and shows a popup in response. You can show different popups to new visitors versus returning visitors.

Show Popups to the Right Visitors, Based on Behavior

Show a popup only on certain pages, by device or browser, or only to visitors who came from a specific ad or email link. You can also target visitors based on prior behavior, such as closing a popup before or viewing several pages. Basic targeting is included in the free plugin; geo, device, and traffic-source targeting require a paid plan.

Popup Analytics and Email Marketing Integrations

Built-in reports show popup views, signups, conversion rate, and — for WooCommerce stores — revenue attributed to each popup. The free plugin includes basic analytics with 7 days of history; paid plans include advanced analytics with unlimited history. You can also connect an email marketing service so new leads sync to your list automatically.

Grow Your Email List

Add newsletter forms and popups wherever you want — after a visitor reads part of a post, when they’re about to leave, or as soon as the page loads. Once someone signs up, connect your email service so the new subscriber is added automatically.

Stop Losing WooCommerce Sales to Cart Abandonment

Cart abandonment recovery popups — showing a discount code or reminder when a shopper is about to leave checkout — require a paid plan (Starter and up). You can build these around specific products, categories, or cart value.

Collect Leads for Any Kind of Business

Build forms for quote requests, appointment bookings, support questions, or webinar signups. Submissions are saved in your own WordPress database, and can be searched, filtered, or exported. Lead export is a paid-plan feature; free-plan leads remain viewable in your dashboard.

When Should Your Popup Show Up?

  • Exit Intent — shows when someone is about to leave the page. Works on desktop and mobile.
  • Time Delay — shows after a set number of seconds.
  • Scroll Depth — shows after a visitor scrolls down a set amount.
  • Click Trigger — shows when someone clicks a button, link, or image.
  • Inactivity — shows if a visitor stops interacting with the page. (Paid plans.)
  • Page Load — shows as soon as the page opens.

Who Should See Your Popup?

  • Show it only on certain pages, posts, or categories.
  • Show a different popup on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
  • Show it only to visitors who came from a certain ad or email.
  • Show new visitors a welcome offer and returning visitors a different message.
  • Set a start and end date so the campaign runs on its own.
  • Set a limit so the same visitor doesn’t see the popup too many times.

Advanced targeting options (geo, device, traffic source, scheduling) require a paid plan; basic page- and device-level targeting is included free.

WooCommerce Features

  • Cart abandonment recovery popups (paid plans).
  • Exit intent offers at checkout.
  • Coupon code popups; advanced coupon rules require a paid plan.
  • Popups by product or category.
  • Upsell and cross-sell popups.
  • Collect emails before checkout.
  • Revenue reporting per popup (advanced history on paid plans).
  • Product suggestions based on cart contents.

A Form Builder Built for Lead Generation

  • Email opt-in and newsletter signup forms.
  • General lead generation and contact forms.
  • Multi-step forms with custom fields.
  • GDPR consent checkboxes.
  • Google reCAPTCHA spam protection.
  • CSV lead export (paid plans).
  • Instant email notification on new leads.

Popup Reports

  • Popup Views – how many times a popup was shown.
  • Lead Conversions – how many viewers became a lead.
  • Conversion Rate – percentage of visitors who took action.
  • Revenue Generated – WooCommerce revenue attributed to a popup.
  • Device Performance – results by desktop vs. mobile.
  • Campaign Results – a summary view per campaign.

Free plans include 7 days of analytics history; paid plans include unlimited history.

Email Marketing Integrations

Connects with Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, GetResponse, Drip, Brevo, and Klaviyo, so new leads are added to your existing list automatically. For any other service, use Webhooks.

Works With Your Existing Website

Works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks Builder, WooCommerce, WPML, and most WordPress themes.

Your Data Stays in Your Hands

Your popups, leads, and reports are stored in your own WordPress database. Nothing is sent anywhere else unless you turn on a specific integration. Even then, only that one service gets the data, under its own privacy policy.

Full privacy policy: https://ysleadgen.com/privacy-policy

Credits

YS LeadGen is developed and supported by the team at YS Innovations.

Privacy Policy

YS LeadGen stores all popup settings, leads, form entries, and reports inside your own WordPress database. No personal data goes to an outside service unless you turn on an integration.

When you turn on an integration (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, GetResponse, Drip, Brevo, Klaviyo, or Webhooks), your lead data is sent to that one platform. It follows that platform’s own privacy policy. No data is sent to YS Innovations’ own servers.

Full privacy policy: https://ysleadgen.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “YS LeadGen” or “Popup Builder”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Go to LeadGen in your admin sidebar to create your first campaign.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  5. Go to LeadGen in your admin sidebar to create your first campaign.

After activation

  1. Choose a popup type from the template library, or start from a blank canvas.
  2. Set a trigger, such as exit intent or scroll depth.
  3. Set display rules to choose which pages or visitors see the popup.
  4. Connect an email marketing integration for automatic lead syncing.
  5. Publish the campaign and check the Analytics tab to track performance.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes, the core plugin is free to install and use. The free plan includes up to 3 active popups, core popup types, basic triggers and targeting, a limited template selection, and basic analytics with 7-day history. Features such as unlimited popups, cart abandonment recovery, advanced targeting, lead export, and branding removal require a paid plan (Starter and up). See the Free vs. Paid Plans section above for the full breakdown.

Where are my leads stored?

Inside your own WordPress database. Nothing goes to an outside service unless you turn on an integration yourself.

Can I export my leads?

CSV lead export is available on paid plans (Starter and up). Free-plan leads remain viewable in your dashboard.

Will my popups look good on phones and tablets?

Yes. Every popup works well on mobile by default. You can also set separate rules for each device on paid plans.

Is this plugin GDPR friendly?

Yes. You can add a GDPR consent checkbox to any form.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Everything is built using a visual, drag-and-drop editor.

Does it support Google reCAPTCHA?

Yes, this helps keep spam out of your leads.

Can I use this on a multilingual website?

Yes, it works with WPML. The plugin interface also supports translation via standard WordPress localization tools.

Does this replace my email marketing service?

No. YS LeadGen captures leads and sends them to the email marketing service you already use (Mailchimp, HubSpot, Omnisend, GetResponse, Drip, Brevo, Klaviyo, or any service via Webhooks). It doesn’t send email campaigns itself.

Can I try paid features before upgrading?

Plan details and current pricing are available at ysleadgen.com/pricing. The free plan has no time limit, so you can evaluate the core plugin for as long as you’d like before deciding whether to upgrade.

Will this slow down my website?

The plugin loads a minimal set of scripts, and popup assets only load when needed.

What if I run into a problem?

Go to the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org. Free-plan users get community support; paid plans include live chat and email support.

How can I support this plugin?

The best ways are to leave a review on WordPress.org, or report bugs and feature requests on the support forum — both help us prioritize what to build next.

2.1.9 – July 18, 2026

  • Added shareable preview links — generate a public preview URL for any campaign so teammates or clients can review it without logging into WordPress.
  • Added AI Insights (paid plans) — predictive analytics, optimization scoring, A/B winner prediction, and actionable suggestions from campaign performance.
  • Added Kit (ConvertKit) integration — automatically sync new leads and subscribers with your Kit account.
  • Improved onboarding wizard layout and responsiveness, including clearer integration setup steps.

2.1.8 – July 10, 2026

  • Added Team Collaboration (paid plans) — invite team members to manage campaigns together with shared workspace access.
  • Added White Label mode (paid plans) — customize or remove YS LeadGen branding from the plugin interface for client websites.
  • Added ActiveCampaign integration — automatically sync new leads and subscribers with your ActiveCampaign account.

2.1.7 – July 4, 2026

  • Added Age Gate campaigns — restrict or verify visitor age before showing content.
  • Added Cookie Consent management with a built-in consent engine.
  • Added Privacy Policy acceptance forms.
  • Added Survey and NPS (Net Promoter Score) forms.
  • Improved validation and sanitization for survey and consent form submissions.
  • Updated template library with new Age Gate, Cookie Consent, Privacy Policy, Survey, and NPS designs.

2.1.6 – June 26, 2026

  • Added Brevo and Klaviyo email marketing integrations.
  • Added Survey Popup and Social Proof popup types.
  • Added Video Popup for YouTube, Vimeo, and self-hosted video.
  • Added Content Locker to restrict content until an action is completed.
  • Minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

2.1.5 – June 18, 2026

  • Added AI headline and CTA generators.
  • Added AI-powered smart template recommendations.
  • Added category- and industry-wise template filtering.
  • Added a new Lead Magnet & Giveaway template category.

2.1.4 – June 11, 2026

  • Added Dynamic Product Recommendations for WooCommerce popups.
  • Added cookie-based targeting for personalized display rules.

2.1.3 – May 28, 2026

  • Added GetResponse and Drip integrations.
  • Added multi-step popup flows and onsite retargeting.
  • Added revenue analytics for WooCommerce campaigns.
  • Added inline and embedded forms.
  • Updated tested-up-to version to WordPress 7.0.

2.1.2 – May 9, 2026

  • Added A/B split testing.
  • Added behavior-based targeting.
  • Added smart frequency controls and cooldown management.
  • Added popup dismissal tracking.

2.1.1 – April 27, 2026

  • Fixed an admin dashboard loading issue on certain server configurations.
  • Added captured lead page URL to the leads table.

2.1.0 – April 15, 2026

  • Added Fullscreen, Slide-In, Yes/No, and Spin-to-Win popup types.
  • Expanded the template library across all popup categories.

2.0.0 – March 26, 2026

  • Major release — full WooCommerce popup integration.
  • Added Add to Cart, Cart Page, Checkout Page, Cart Exit Intent, Checkout Exit Intent, and Product Page triggers.
  • Added cart value, product, category, and user role conditions.
  • Added coupon popups with cart and product/category restrictions.

1.1.5 – February 3, 2026

  • Security fix: resolved unauthenticated AJAX access vulnerability (CVE-2026-1255). Immediate update recommended for all users on earlier versions.

See full changelog
